-1 = automatic routing. 0-%1$d = head-unit audio channel number (BYD: 0 call, 6 Bluetooth call, 14 navigation); \"Test\" plays a short tone through it. Applies when settings close.

Keep session on window shrink
Keep CarPlay connected when a reverse or 360 camera window shrinks it

When the window shrinks inside its original size (for example a reverse or 360 camera view), scale the existing CarPlay picture instead of reconnecting at the new size. Rotation and bar changes still reconnect.
BYD
Hide stock call popups (experimental)
Dismiss the BYD call popup while connected CarPlay is on screen

While connected CarPlay is on screen, use the stock HiCar interface to dismiss call popups. No ADB required. A popup may briefly appear before closing. With "Disconnect iPhone Bluetooth during CarPlay" on, popups normally do not appear at all. Turn off to restore the stock call interface.
Vehicle data (DiLink 4)
Vehicle speed and gear for tunnel navigation
Read-only BYD vehicle data when the iPhone requests it. Requires authorized network ADB and Location reporting.
Electric battery and range for Apple Maps (experimental)
Report battery and electric range. For DM-i, fuel range is excluded. Requires authorized network ADB; iPhone support determines availability.
Vehicle supports GB/T DC charging
Enable only if your variant supports DC charging; otherwise only the AC inlet is reported.
Battery capacity (kWh, 0 = automatic)
Use your variant\'s capacity if automatic detection cannot read the remaining energy (0-200 kWh).

The check may show a debugging authorization dialog. Background sampling never asks for approval; unavailable vehicle data is skipped while CarPlay continues. Applies on the next CarPlay connection.

The iPhone uses this address to recognise the car. Takes effect on the next connection; after changing it, forget this car on the iPhone and pair again.
Disconnect iPhone Bluetooth calls during CarPlay (recommended)
Calls go through CarPlay; the stock phone shows no popup
Disconnect iPhone Bluetooth music during CarPlay
Music goes through CarPlay instead of Bluetooth

CarPlay asks the head unit to drop these Bluetooth links. If music over Wi-Fi stutters, raise the music buffer under Audio, or turn off the music option to keep music on Bluetooth (the iPhone then shows Bluetooth as its output). Both links are restored 15 s after CarPlay ends. Applies on the next connection.
Wi-Fi scan diagnostics
Reading…
Reads through ADB which apps and system services scan Wi-Fi, and writes it to the log. Frequent scans make Wi-Fi P2P stall. Export the logs afterwards.
Wrote %1$d lines to the log. Export the logs to send them.
Call audio channel
For calls on BYD head units try 6 (Bluetooth call channel) first, then 0 (call channel). The test tone plays through the chosen channel.
Test: send call info to the cluster
Testing (10 s)…

Sends the instrument cluster a 10-second test call (name \"CarPlay test\" and a call timer) through ADB, the way BYD\'s Bluetooth phone does. Watch whether the cluster shows it and whether the AC fan drops.

Results (0 usually means accepted):
%1$s

Did the cluster show the call, and did the AC fan drop?
